study type: secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: preterm neonates who received positive pressure ventilation
cohort: The study included 3446 preterm neonates, with a mean age of 0.65 hours at the time of data collection, from India and Pakistan.
finding: Key maternal (antepartum hemorrhage) and neonatal (positive pressure ventilation, hypothermia, congenital malformations) factors were identified as predictors of preterm neonatal mortality.
followup_time: N/A (the outcome is mortality, implicitly within the neonatal period, but a specific duration is not stated beyond the mean age at data collection)
